title: Chapter 49 Changes In Panel Properties
content:
Chapter 49 Changes In Panel Properties

To obtain a combat profession, in addition to learning it through training in special buildings such as military camps.

Another method is to use a job transfer certificate.

Zhao Bangde has the cavalry job transfer certificate, but it requires 2,000 military merit points.

The "military camp" building blueprint requires 50,000 points.

Although Wang Shuo's military merit points have exceeded 1,000 points, it is still far from enough.

Wang Shuo thought that he still had a "flaming spear" blueprint. After asking, Zhao Bangde did not have the corresponding materials. Wang Shuo could not help but feel a little disappointed.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo first exchanged 3 war horses for his three generals, and each war horse had 200 military merit points.

Gong Zheng still lacked a fine large shield, and Wang Shuo used 400 points to exchange for a fine quality "bronze large shield".

The main reason was that his military merit points were not enough now, and he still had to go to brush the skeleton soldiers.

However, it was late at this time, so he had to wait until tomorrow to act.

The next morning, Wang Shuo and others stood on the Gobi again.

After updating his equipment, Wang Shuo started his journey to earn military merit points again.

With war horses, their mobility has been greatly improved, and their efficiency is several times that of yesterday.

After they all become cavalrymen, and with the cavalry squad medal, their combat effectiveness will be a qualitative leap. Wang Shuo is looking forward to it.

In the four directions of the Gobi, there is also a level 10 boss. Wang Shuo took the task and swept with his subordinates!

With his current strong strength, he quickly killed them one by one.

He got three soul crystals and three weapons again, a piercing bow, a wrought iron gun, and a pair of two-handed copper hammers.

Of these three weapons, Wang Shuo used the wrought iron gun himself, gave the piercing bow to Gong Kai, and the copper hammer to Gong Zheng. When fighting on horseback, he just needed a handy weapon.

In this way, the combat effectiveness of Wang Shuo's team has reached a new level.

Moreover, his military merit points, after a day of crazy killing, directly broke through the 5,000 mark.

If the nearby skeleton soldiers had not been almost killed by them, this number would be even higher.

After returning to the camp, Wang Shuo directly exchanged a cavalry transfer certificate, so that he could start the combat profession before other players.

[Found that the player has a "cavalry" transfer certificate, do you want to use it? ]

"Yes."

[Congratulations on becoming a cavalry, the combat attribute panel is opened, and the command attribute is opened. ]

[Since you are the first player in this area to have a combat profession, reward: command +10]

[Detected that the player is the first to open a life profession and the first to open a combat profession, reward: qualification level +1, from E level to D level. ]

[System announcement: Congratulations to player ID: 5678 Wang Shuo, the first to obtain a combat profession, open the reputation value attribute, reputation +50. ]

At this time, Wang Shuo's head was buzzing.

A series of system prompts and announcements made Wang Shuo a little overwhelmed.

Like Wang Shuo, other players in this area were also confused.

"What's going on? The boss is making trouble again!"

"Why did he open the combat profession? Please help me!"

"He's cheating. He's definitely cheating. I want to report him."

"This is destroying the balance of the game. He's the first one several times. How can we play this?"

...

In the [chat channel], everyone began to complain in an unfriendly tone.

If it was before, it must be "Boss, awesome!"

Then +1, and then +1.

Now, after confirming the opposition relationship between each other, the players began to denounce him, thinking that if the opponent is strong, they may suffer.

Wang Shuo ignored these jealous players and checked his character information attribute panel.

[Basic attribute panel]

[ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 8]

[Strength: 25 (10+15)]

[Constitution: 25 (15+10)]

[Agility: 13 (10+3)]

[Energy: 18 (17+1)]

[Life skills: 1. Smooth the waters, 2. Make a mud pit. ]

(Qualification: D level, each level up provides 2 free attribute points.)

(Free attributes that can be allocated: 9)

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 25+25]

[Defense power: 20]

[Command value: 10]

[Reputation value: 50]

[Health value: 950]

[Skills: None]

[Combat skills: 1. Summon mud monsters, 2. Eye of delusion. 】

【Equipment: 1. Iron Spear (Excellent); 2. Advanced Crocodile Leather Armor (Gold); 3. Crocodile Leather Boots; 4. Rebound Necklace; 5. Horse Brand. 】

【Overall Evaluation: Now you have a certain combat power and can fight monsters of the same level alone, but this is nothing great, right? Keep a low profile and don't waste time! 】

After seeing these changes, Wang Shuo was a little complacent. Very good and powerful!

For the next ranking and the battle for the "Village Construction Order", Wang Shuo is more confident.

Wang Shuo took out the "Cavalry Squad Medal" and found that it was already usable.

【Do you want to create a cavalry squad? 】

"Yes."

【Please name the cavalry squad. 】

Wang Shuo thought for a while and decided to use "Swift Scout" as the name of this cavalry squad.

[The Swift Scout Cavalry Squad was named successfully. ]

[Swift Scout Cavalry Squad Medal: Provides 20% speed bonus, 5% attack power bonus, and 5% defense bonus for the squad cavalry. Squad size: 1/10. ]

Wang Shuo was very satisfied after seeing this bonus.

However, if he wanted to transfer all three brothers to cavalry, he still needed 3,000 military merit points.

I don't know if he can get them together tomorrow, after all, there are only a few skeleton soldiers left nearby.

Considering that there is no one to take care of his territory, Wang Shuo used 150 military merit points to exchange for the cheapest tool man.

[ID: 3334 Philomena]

Wang Shuo renamed him Xiaona, who can be Wang Shuo's maid, responsible for cooking and taking care of the farmland and the breeding farm.

Back in the shelter, Wang Shuo gave Xiaona the authority to take food out of the warehouse and told her to prepare dinner.

Then he washed off all the stains.

After the three Gong brothers finished washing, everyone came to the hall and prepared to eat.

This was the first time that Wang Shuo and his generals formally sat together for dinner.

However, due to the influence of the system seal, the three brothers were not active and could only answer some simple questions from Wang Shuo and execute orders.

This made Wang Shuo a little bored. After eating, Wang Shuo returned to his room.

He began to think about the next arrangements.

There are still two days left, and the battle for the "Village Building Order" is about to begin!

Wang Shuo looked at the [Task Bar] again and found that there were only 213 people alive in the current area.

The remaining ones are basically the elites among the elites.

He browsed the trading house again, wanting to see the latest commodity trading trends.

As a result, there were few consignment items in the trading house, on the one hand because the number of players decreased sharply, and on the other hand because of the elimination round.

Everyone has entered a relatively stable period, and they are all desperately developing the war potential of their own territories to enhance their own strength.
